_note: Single-table questions (the SQL adapter's training distribution), written before any adapter results were seen. Same schema and seed data as eval_sql.json.

questions.question: How many students are in year 1?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE year = 1

questions.question: What is the lowest GPA among Biology majors?
questions.sql: SELECT MIN(gpa) FROM students WHERE major = 'Biology'

questions.question: List the names of students with a GPA between 3.0 and 3.6.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE gpa BETWEEN 3.0 AND 3.6

questions.question: Which majors have more than one student?
questions.sql: SELECT major FROM students GROUP BY major HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

questions.question: What is the average GPA of students in year 3 or higher?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students WHERE year >= 3

questions.question: List the names of the three students with the lowest GPA.
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students ORDER BY gpa ASC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many students are there in each year?
questions.sql: SELECT year, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY year

questions.question: What is the name of the Economics major with the highest GPA?
questions.sql: SELECT name FROM students WHERE major = 'Economics' ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the total number of credits offered by the Mathematics department?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(credits) FROM courses WHERE dept = 'Mathematics'

questions.question: List the course titles that have exactly 4 credits.
questions.sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE credits = 4

questions.question: Which department offers the most courses?
questions.sql: SELECT dept FROM courses GROUP BY dept ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average number of credits per course in each department?
questions.sql: SELECT dept, AVG(credits) FROM courses GROUP BY dept

questions.question: What is the highest grade recorded in course 3?
questions.sql: SELECT MAX(grade) FROM enrollments WHERE course_id = 3

questions.question: How many enrollments have a grade below 3.2?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollments WHERE grade < 3.2

questions.question: Which student IDs are enrolled in more than one course?
questions.sql: SELECT student_id FROM enrollments GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
